recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, low-key photographic scene of a figure lying down in darkness, framed by aggressive, high-contrast horizontal bands of typography. The image uses a split-tone color inversion effect on the top text and a clean sans-serif footer.
coreVisualRelationships: Top text interacts with a horizontal split-plane, inverting colors across the horizon line.
The central subject is submerged in deep shadows with minimal blue-toned highlights.
The bottom text acts as a stable, high-contrast anchor against the dark void.
coreInvariants: Low-angle, cinematic lighting on the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central horizontal figure, occupying the middle third of the frame, scaled to feel intimate yet distant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, split-color header text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the bold header down to the subject's face/hands, then settling on the clean footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dominant black void surrounding the subject, creating a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with very low saturation; nearly monochromatic.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to black, white, and one cool highlight color

letterConstructionRules: Color inversion at the horizontal midpoint
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'C' and 'U' are elongated into tall stadium shapes.
The 'E' features short, uniform horizontal bars.

treatment.fill: inverted (white on black / black on white)

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme vertical display vs. wide-tracked geometric anchor.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary condensed weight for the header.
Clean, authoritative skeleton for the footer.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic, low-key photograph of a person lying down in a dark room. Use cool blue rim lighting to define the profile of the face and hands. The background must be pure black. The top 20% of the image should be a solid white horizontal bar meeting the black background at a sharp edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large, vertically stretched sans-serif text across the top white/black boundary. The portion of the letters on the white bar must be black, and the portion on the black background must be white. Place wide-tracked, clean sans-serif text at the bottom center in white.

verificationChecks: Is the top text perfectly bisected by the color change?
Is the subject lighting sufficiently moody and low-key?
Is the bottom text tracking wide enough to span the width of the subject?
Are there any warm colors present that should be removed?

adjustableVariables: Height of the top white bar
Tracking width of the footer text
Vertical stretch ratio of the header
mustRedesign: Any specific logos or brand marks
Specific facial features of the subject
Prop details that imply specific brand names

mustAchieve: Perfect horizontal alignment of the split-tone effect

postGenerationChecks: Check for color bleed at the text inversion line.
Ensure the blue highlights don't become overly saturated.
Verify the footer text is perfectly centered.
Confirm the header text is legible despite the inversion.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [High-Contrast Split-Tone Header] + [Low-Key Cinematic Subject] + [Wide-Tracked Geometric Footer] to create a [Noir Urban] aesthetic.
